content: MK lists further doubtful attributions on this page: a Makhzan al-Gharāʾib (Arabic), which Āqā Buzurg says he has often seen in collections of Ibn Turka's works, so Ibn Turka is strongly suggested as author (Bodleian catalogue follows); a Sharḥ al-Hidāya whose attribution to one Khwāja Ṣāʾin al-Dīn makes Ibn Turka a possible candidate; and a Persian Taqrīr Masʾalat al-Tawḥīd in a 1309/1892 copy.
refers_to_primary: Makhzan al-Gharāʾib; Sharḥ al-Hidāya; Taqrīr Masʾalat al-Tawḥīd
